title: Propagate per-method JmapError contract to extension-server siblings
description: JMAP-510h.40 rewrote the module-level 'Each handler returns Err(JmapError)' paragraph in canonical jmap-mail-server (9 modules) and jmap-filenode-server as a per-method-shape list that names only errors the code can return (adds requestTooLarge, tooManyChanges, anchorNotFound, fromAccountNotFound etc.; drops unreachable ones). Mirror to chat, calendars, contacts, tasks, sharing (and metadata/vtc/scene/graph if they carry the paragraph): trace each module's error sites (JmapError::*, enforce_max_objects_in_*, jmap_server::handle_* generics, BackendChangesError -> cannotCalculateChanges/tooManyChanges, resolve_query_start -> anchorNotFound) and rewrite the list. Per AGENTS.md Canonical Templates sweep rule.
